verdict.rationale: A GPU cloud could plausibly offer in-product AI insights, such as usage or cost suggestions, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no such feature. Runpod's MCP servers and agent skills let external coding agents manage resources in natural language, and its Public Endpoints and vLLM workers are model-hosting building blocks. Both are adjacent capabilities, not AI-generated insights about the user's data inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
